grid.gaps_between_cells: none — cells touch edge to edge
grid.layout_note: Draw pigs ONLY in the top 2 rows (y=0 to y=511). Leave rows 3-4 (y=512 to y=1023) completely empty — no sprites, fully transparent.

alignment_guides.instruction: The uploaded reference image shows the grid. Black lines (#000000) are cell boundaries. Magenta lines (#FF00FF) are character alignment guides — the character's head must touch the magenta head-line and feet must touch the magenta feet-line in each row. AFTER drawing all characters, DELETE every #FF00FF magenta pixel. Keep characters INSIDE the black #000000 grid cells.

grid_dividers.positions: horizontal at y=256 and vertical at x=256, x=512, x=768
grid_dividers.purpose: cell boundaries — no character part may cross these

character_guides.purpose: character height alignment — top of pig touches top guide, base touches bottom guide
character_guides.removal: delete all #FF00FF magenta pixels from the final image

rows.facing: profile-left — pig faces toward 9 o'clock (left edge of image), viewer sees pig's right side
rows.what_viewer_sees: the right side of the pig curled up sleeping on the ground
rows.column_1: sleep frame 1 — curled up on ground, legs tucked under, eyes closed, ears folded down, peaceful
rows.column_2: sleep frame 2 — gentle breathing in, body expands very slightly, snout twitches
rows.column_3: sleep frame 3 — gentle breathing out, body settles back down, completely still
rows.column_4: sleep frame 4 — tiny ear flick or tail curl change, returning toward frame 1 rest position

rows.facing: profile-right — pig faces toward 3 o'clock (right edge of image), viewer sees pig's left side
rows.what_viewer_sees: the left side of the pig curled up sleeping on the ground

subject.name: Pig
subject.description: cozy domesticated farm pig, stylized to match a Greek mythology farming game world
subject.body: rounded, warm pink/rose tones with earthy shadow tones
subject.features: small floppy ears, stubby snout, curly tail, short legs
subject.build: small and rounded — readable at small scale, friendly not realistic
subject.pose_notes: curled up or lying low on the ground — clearly sleeping, not standing. The pig's overall height is shorter than when standing because it is lying down.

style.aesthetic: pixelated retro style, high quality and modern like Stardew Valley — clean readable sprites with flat shading
style.outline: dark 1-pixel outline around the entire character
style.shading: flat cluster shading, no smooth gradients
style.antialiasing: none — crisp pixel edges only, no blur
style.character_height: 70% of cell height (approximately 180 pixels in each 256-pixel cell)
style.character_centering: horizontally centered in each cell, top of pig touching top guide, base touching bottom guide

rules: this is ONE image containing 8 small pigs in the top half of a grid — NOT 8 separate images
every pig in all 8 cells is the SAME pig with the SAME body shape, proportions, and colors
this is a PIG — a small, round, cute farm animal. Not a person. Not a boar.
MUST match the pig_walk spritesheet exactly — same pig, same proportions, same colors. Only the pose changes from walking to sleeping
ONLY draw pigs in the TOP 2 ROWS (y=0 to y=511). The bottom half of the image must be completely empty and transparent
the pig is LYING DOWN / CURLED UP — not standing. It should look clearly asleep
no pig may cross a cell boundary into a neighboring cell
all tops within a row must align on the row's top guide line
all bases within a row must align on the row's bottom guide line
identical top-left lighting across all 8 cells
no tilt or rotation on any pig
